worlds.name: Oceanic
worlds.form: Three readable islands and broad shallow-water bands.
worlds.material: Satin ocean, matte sand, sparse foam.

worlds.name: Verdant
worlds.form: Rounded canopies, a winding river and quiet clearings.
worlds.material: Soft moss, brushed grass, muted stone.

worlds.name: Desert
worlds.form: Dune ribbons, rounded mesas and one small oasis.

worlds.name: Frozen
worlds.form: Broad snow caps, pale lakes and softened ice ridges.
worlds.material: Powder snow and translucent satin ice.

worlds.name: Volcanic
worlds.form: Rounded basalt, a quiet crater and a few warm seams.
worlds.material: Matte mineral rock; restrained lava emission.

worlds.name: Crystal
worlds.form: Few clustered crystals around a shallow teal pool.
worlds.material: Cloudy mineral translucency; no mirror finish.

art_direction.camera: Near orthographic, 25 degrees above the equator. Keep the same framing and warm upper-left light across world types.
art_direction.terrain: Solid spherical base, gently rounded forms. Large landmarks first, fine detail last.
art_direction.lighting: Large warm key from upper left, cool fill at roughly one third of key energy, soft ambient occlusion. Renderer values are starting points.

detail_levels.hero_480px_plus: Up to 3 main landmarks; finer paint and vegetation may show.
detail_levels.card_160_to_479px: Keep 1 to 2 landmarks and 3 to 5 broad color masses.
detail_levels.map_48_to_159px: Keep the silhouette and 2 to 3 color masses; omit tiny flora, veins and glints.

art_direction.art_colors: Moodboard triads are illustration suggestions, not new UI tokens or sampled pixel guarantees.

iconography.live_bounds: Generally 2 to 22 on each axis, with optical exceptions.
iconography.rule: Use the supplied 16px optical variants at 16px. Do not reduce the 24px master further.

background.grain: Static monochrome texture behind content only. Remove it at small sizes or on low-power views.
background.copy_rule: Preserve a calm area under copy. No bright dust bands or visible grain behind words.

motion.name: Hover or focus color
motion.change: Color or border only. Focus appears immediately.

motion.name: World focus
motion.change: Camera shift at most 8% of viewport. No roll.

motion.name: Comet arrival
motion.change: One short curved path, up to 140px in the UI.
motion.reduced: 150ms arrival fade; no trail or travel.

motion.name: Bloom reveal
motion.change: Opacity 0 to 1; new detail scales 0.96 to 1.

motion.name: Ambient drift
motion.change: Full cycle: 0px to -4px to 0px. One featured world.

motion.name: Planet rotation
motion.change: One full turn around its own axis. Optional.
motion.reduced: Static view, with manual step controls.

motion.name: Moon orbit
motion.change: One full orbit. Small, constant speed. Optional.
motion.reduced: Moon remains at its resting position.

motion_principles: Give feedback immediately; never delay a successful action for an effect.
Use short, calm interface transitions and slow ambient movement.
No bounce, spring overshoot, camera roll, flashing stars or shaking errors.
Use one featured ambient animation per view; pause it when hidden or offscreen.
Respect reduced motion and provide a persistent Pause motion control for continuous ambient movement.
